name: BLE-02 设备页断连 → 退避自动重连（不重扫列表）→ 返回 discover 轮次重扫仍在线

setup.code: if (!globalThis.__bleMock) throw new Error('ble-mock 未注入'); return globalThis.__bleMock.getState();

steps.code: const deadline = Date.now() + 8000; for (;;) { const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; if (!p || p.route !== 'pages/scan/scan') throw new Error('当前不在 scan 页：route=' + (p && p.route)); const hit = (p.data.discovered || []).find((d) => d && (d.name === 'ML-8DCC' || d.deviceId === 'CC:8D:A2:C2:56:62')); if (hit) return { deviceId: hit.deviceId, name: hit.name }; if (Date.now() >= deadline) throw new Error('扫描结果无 ML-8DCC：discovered=' + JSON.stringify(p.data.discovered || []) + ' scanning=' + p.data.scanning + ' error=' + (p.data.error || '')); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); }

const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; const hit = (p.data.discovered || []).find((d) => d && d.name === 'ML-8DCC'); if (!hit) throw new Error('扫描结果丢失，无法连接：discovered=' + JSON.stringify(p.data.discovered || [])); return await p.onTapDevice({ currentTarget: { dataset: { deviceId: hit.deviceId, name: hit.name } } });

const deadline = Date.now() + 8000; for (;;) { const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; const d = p && p.route === 'pages/discover/discover' ? (p.data.devices || []).find((x) => x && x.name === 'ML-8DCC') : null; if (d && d.online) { if (p.data.scanError) throw new Error('discover 重扫报错：' + p.data.scanError); return { deviceId: d.deviceId, name: d.name, online: d.online }; } if (Date.now() >= deadline) throw new Error('discover 卡片未点亮：route=' + ((pages[pages.length - 1] || {}).route) + ' devices=' + JSON.stringify(((pages[pages.length - 1] || {}).data || {}).devices || []) + ' scanError=' + (((pages[pages.length - 1] || {}).data || {}).scanError || '')); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); }

const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; const d = (p.data.devices || []).find((x) => x && x.name === 'ML-8DCC'); if (!d) throw new Error('设备卡缺失：devices=' + JSON.stringify(p.data.devices || [])); return p.onTapCard({ currentTarget: { dataset: { name: d.name, deviceId: d.deviceId || '' } } });

const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; if (p.route !== 'pages/device/device') throw new Error('未进入设备页：route=' + p.route); if (p.data.connected !== true) throw new Error('设备页未连接：connected=' + p.data.connected + ' reconnecting=' + p.data.reconnecting); return { deviceId: p.deviceId, connected: p.data.connected };
const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; const r = await p._dcRequestToken(); return { granted: !!r.granted, reason: r.reason || '' };

const st = globalThis.__bleMock.getState(); const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; return { scanCount: st.scanCount, connectionCount: st.connectionCount, connected: st.connected, pageConnected: !!p.data.connected };
const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; return { connected: !!p.data.connected, reconnecting: !!p.data.reconnecting };
const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; const r = await p._dcRequestToken(); return { granted: !!r.granted, reason: r.reason || '', connected: !!p.data.connected };
const r = await new Promise((resolve) => { wx.navigateBack({ success: () => resolve({ ok: true }), fail: () => resolve({ ok: false }) }); }); return r;

const deadline = Date.now() + 8000; for (;;) { const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; const d = p && p.route === 'pages/discover/discover' ? (p.data.devices || []).find((x) => x && x.name === 'ML-8DCC') : null; if (d && d.online) { const st = globalThis.__bleMock.getState(); if (st.scanCount < 3) throw new Error('返回列表未自动重扫（轮次扫描）：scanCount=' + st.scanCount); if (p.data.scanError) throw new Error('discover 重扫报错：' + p.data.scanError); return { name: d.name, online: d.online, deviceId: d.deviceId, scanCount: st.scanCount }; } if (Date.now() >= deadline) throw new Error('返回列表后卡片未点亮：route=' + ((pages[pages.length - 1] || {}).route) + ' devices=' + JSON.stringify(((pages[pages.length - 1] || {}).data || {}).devices || []) + ' scanError=' + (((pages[pages.length - 1] || {}).data || {}).scanError || '')); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); }
